import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(data[0]); P = int(data[1])
    D = N*(N-1)//2; K = D+1
    cs = np.arange(K, dtype=np.int64)
    one_plus_c = (cs+1) % P
    pow_s = np.empty((N+1, K), dtype=np.int64)
    pow_s[0] = 1
    for s in range(1, N+1):
        pow_s[s] = (pow_s[s-1]*one_plus_c) % P
    pow_within = np.empty((N+1, K), dtype=np.int64)
    pow_within[0] = 1
    for t in range(1, N+1):
        pow_within[t] = (pow_within[t-1]*pow_s[t-1]) % P
    cross = np.empty((N+1, N+1, K), dtype=np.int64)
    for s in range(N+1):
        base = (pow_s[s]-1) % P
        cur = np.ones(K, dtype=np.int64)
        cross[s,0] = cur.copy()
        for t in range(1, N+1):
            cur = (cur*base) % P
            cross[s,t] = cur.copy()
    fact = [1]*(K+1)
    for i in range(1, K+1):
        fact[i] = fact[i-1]*i % P
    inv_fact = [pow(fact[i], P-2, P) for i in range(K+1)]
    NH = N//2
    dp = {}
    dp[(1,1,1,0)] = np.ones(K, dtype=np.int64)
    by_n = [[] for _ in range(N+1)]
    by_n[1].append((1,1,0))
    for n in range(1, N):
        for (e, s, p) in by_n[n]:
            v = dp[(n,e,s,p)]
            for t in range(1, N-n+1):
                new_n = n+t; new_p = 1-p
                new_e = e + (t if new_p==0 else 0)
                if new_e > NH: continue
                if new_n - new_e > NH: continue
                mult = (pow_within[t]*cross[s,t]) % P
                mult = (mult*inv_fact[t]) % P
                contribution = (v*mult) % P
                nk = (new_n, new_e, t, new_p)
                if nk in dp:
                    dp[nk] = (dp[nk]+contribution) % P
                else:
                    dp[nk] = contribution
                    by_n[new_n].append((new_e, t, new_p))
    F = np.zeros(K, dtype=np.int64)
    for (cn,e,s,p), v in dp.items():
        if cn==N and e==NH:
            F = (F+v) % P
    F = (F*fact[N-1]) % P
    cur = F.copy()
    deltas = [int(cur[0])]
    for k in range(1, K):
        cur = (cur[1:]-cur[:-1]) % P
        deltas.append(int(cur[0]))
    F_coef = [0]*K
    F_coef[0] = deltas[0]*inv_fact[0] % P
    cur_poly = [1]
    for k in range(1, K):
        new_poly = [0]*(len(cur_poly)+1)
        shift = (-(k-1)) % P
        for j in range(len(cur_poly)):
            new_poly[j+1] = (new_poly[j+1]+cur_poly[j]) % P
            new_poly[j] = (new_poly[j]+cur_poly[j]*shift) % P
        cur_poly = new_poly
        coef = deltas[k]*inv_fact[k] % P
        for j in range(len(cur_poly)):
            F_coef[j] = (F_coef[j]+cur_poly[j]*coef) % P
    ans = F_coef[N-1:D+1]
    print(' '.join(map(str, ans)))
